resolution.question: Ravi and the private seller of a 2019 hatchback are 40,000 rupees apart. Will they agree on a price in the three days before the seller's posted listing expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ravi and the seller agreed on a price (e.g., a binding acceptance or signed agreement) before 2026-08-23T10:00:00+05:30. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
